office_does: The county clerk is clerk of the superior court and keeps its case files, dockets, juror records, and the court's orders and judgments.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Kimberly A. Allen (Prefers Republican Party), clerk since her 2006 election, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Grant County Clerk since 2006 and former law-firm office manager; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Serves on the state clerks' association education committee and mentors new county clerks [S1]
Office manager and legal secretary at Schultheis Tabler Wallace for 11 years before taking office [S1]
